name: week
title: Research review this week
subtitle: Fictional demo until your own records are imported

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,title,owner,due_on,issue from attention_queue order by due_on nulls last,title

sections.title: Evidence coverage
sections.sql: select study,title,usable_support,blocked_citations,contradictions,known_participants from finding_checks order by study,title

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,evidence_current from decision_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select study,title,permission,retention_due,issue from note_checks where not coalesce(usable,false) or retention_due<=current_date+30 order by retention_due nulls first,title
